text.Trading Post:
How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, gain either 1 Trade or 1 Authority (but not both). Also, at any time during your turn you may scrap Trading Post to gain 3 Combat.
 Strategy ==
With only a 1 Trade or 1 Authority bonus to offer and 4 defense, Trading Post is one of the weakest base choices. However as an Outpost it can be useful to protect other non-Outpost bases from attack, especially in the early game when it is difficult to remove two bases in one turn.
